network.label: Muskrat Falls
network.heading: Generation in Labrador
network.detail: The generating station is on the lower Churchill River. Nalcor, a provincial Crown corporation, owned the generating station.

network.label: Labrador–Island Link
network.heading: Labrador to Newfoundland
network.detail: The transmission corridor connects the Labrador project to Newfoundland’s grid. It crosses the Strait of Belle Isle and reaches the network near Soldiers Pond.

network.label: Maritime Link
network.heading: Newfoundland to Nova Scotia
network.detail: The Emera-developed link connects Newfoundland to Cape Breton. The subsea length describes this portion of the link, rather than the full interprovincial route.
